items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: They opened with Prez and then Jacquet and then Eddie Law Lockville.

ctx.x: In Philly. They opened with Prez and then Jacquet and then Eddie Law Lockville. I don't know what happened after that. This was in '47, '46.
Now, we were also talking about, you know, the scene changed there during the war years and because of people not wanting to go into the army, that they got into the drugs then?
